Keyboard shortcuts

Every system-wide shortcut, generated from Aurora's keyboard configuration, plus the ones inside Aurora's apps

These are the system-wide shortcuts of a new account, generated from Aurora's default configuration (/usr/share/aurora/labwc/rc.xml). Your own copy is ~/.config/labwc/rc.xml; change them, or add your own, in Settings → Keyboard → Shortcuts. Super+/ shows the ones in effect on screen. They work in both sessions unless marked.

#Launcher

KeysWhat it does
Super (tap) or Super+Space or Super+ASearch and Launchpad
Super+SControl Center
Super+VClipboard history
Super+.Emoji picker

#Aurora AI

KeysWhat it does
Super+HDictation
Super+Shift+RRead selected text aloud
Super+Shift+SpaceAurora Assistant
Super+Shift+WWriting tools

#Apps

KeysWhat it does
Super+Enter or Ctrl+Alt+TNew terminal window
Super+EFiles
Super+ISettings
Super+LLock screen

#Windows

KeysWhat it does
Alt+Tab or Super+TabNext window
Alt+Shift+TabPrevious window
Alt+F4 or Super+QClose window
Super+↑Maximize window
Super+↓Restore window size
Super+MMinimize window
Super+←Snap the window to the left half
Super+→Snap the window to the right half
Super+FFull screen
Super+Ctrl+UMove the window to the top left quarter
Super+Ctrl+IMove the window to the top right quarter
Super+Ctrl+JMove the window to the bottom left quarter
Super+Ctrl+KMove the window to the bottom right quarter
Super+Ctrl+DMove the window to the left third
Super+Ctrl+FMove the window to the center third
Super+Ctrl+GMove the window to the right third
Super+WShow all windows
Ctrl+Shift+EscTask Manager
Super+ZSnap layouts
Super+TKeep window on top

#Zoom

KeysWhat it does
Super+Alt+8Zoom on or off Compatibility session
Super+Alt+=Zoom in Compatibility session
Super+Alt+−Zoom out Compatibility session
Alt+SpaceWindow menu Compatibility session

Super+2Go to workspace 2

Super+4Go to workspace 4

Super+Shift+3Move the window to workspace 3

Super+7Go to workspace 7
Super+8Go to workspace 8
Super+9Go to workspace 9
Super+Shift+5Move the window to workspace 5
Super+Shift+6Move the window to workspace 6

Super+Shift+8Move the window to workspace 8
Super+Shift+9Move the window to workspace 9
Ctrl+Alt+←Previous workspace
Ctrl+Alt+→Next workspace

#Screenshots

KeysWhat it does
Print ScreenScreenshot of the screen
